'''Povdmm4''' is a small map designed for use in [[DMM4]]. It is a large single room with four spawns at the far north, south, east and west. Two [[Yellow Armor|yellow armors]] are available in small alcoves, which are accessible via a shootable switch above each alcove.

The map was created by {{player|Povo-Hat|flag=au}} in [[2001]], after slaving in front of a shareware copy of [[Worldcraft]] for almost 15 minutes. Despite its horrible aesthetics and gameplay, it has gained much popularity for warmup, practice and aim [[LGC|benchmarking]] applications.

==LGC2==
[[LGC]]2 features this map by default, and most LG competitions are commonly held on this map.  The past winners of LGC on Povdmm4 [http://lgc.quakeworld.nu/?action=fame have been]:

* IBC: [[Image:Flag_se.gif]] [[interceptor]] (.br could not participate due to [[LGC#IBC:_povdmm4|ip block]])
* LGC1: [[Image:Flag_br.gif]] [[Zip]]
* LGC2: [[Image:Flag_br.gif]] [[mur]] (3 weeks in a row)

==Trivia==
* Initially designed for [[Rocket Launcher|RL]] only fights
* The handrails were a horrible mistake, but are a legal necessity due to accessibility requirements for disabled or less-able rangers
